tasks.title: Implement and validate 63-bit GF(p) polynomial/root backend

handoff.objective: Implement and unit-validate one exact 63-bit GF(p) polynomial/root backend interface for the archived three-arm B=475 prime systems, without solving any full-width index-calculus system.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether a bounded backend can preserve exact 63-bit coefficients, return complete candidate roots, and pass independent full-point correctness controls where the existing msolve path is invalid or unsupported.
constraints: Prospective handoff only: obtain a lawful claimed GOAL-ICPERF lane, committed dispatch queue and pushed input records before execution. The current two lanes occupy goal concurrency; do not bypass admission.

Keep IDEA-20261017-9cf4b9 proposed and every H/EXP/GOAL status unchanged. Do not solve any of the 21 natural systems or a full-width planted index-calculus system, compare speed, or modify frozen inputs.

Use the direct Sage 10.10.rc0 GF(p) polynomial/root backend candidate, with DOT_SAGE and TMPDIR set to writable /private/tmp during validation; record the exact Sage executable hash, version, build/dependency provenance and environment. The unarchived simple two-variable GB sanity check is a candidate signal only. If the 63-bit backend fails exact controls or cannot reproduce, write failed/unsupported validation and stop. Never raise CRYPTO_AR_MSOLVE_MAX_P or use msolve 0.6.5 as a wide backend.

Parse all coefficients and coordinates as exact integers. Any JSON intermediary that rounds values above 2^53 is invalid. The backend must classify ok, certified_no_solution, timeout, memory, crashed, unsupported and invalid distinctly; unproved absence and missing roots are censored or invalid, never mathematical negatives.

Use independent Sage arithmetic and point addition for reference vectors and the root-to-signed-point checker; do not copy the backend evaluator into its checker. Reject nonlifting coset roots, wrong signs, target mismatches and altered roots.

Use one process at a time and a 4-hour engineering watchdog. A later approved experiment must set 300 s, 8 GiB RSS and 64-primary-model limits on each planted-positive or natural call; this task does not perform those calls.

Run deterministic unit controls only after lawful admission: 64 field identities plus 16 valid and 16 altered S3 triples at p=9223372021248595841; four small synthetic 63-bit ideals (one root, two roots, inconsistent, positive-dimensional); and one <=32-bit complete m=2 regression against enumeration. Parse all 21 frozen systems without solving them. Preserve every failed or unsupported control.
completion_gate: All eleven exact files exist, parse where applicable, carry input and executable SHA-256 bindings, exact commands, environment and unedited stdout/stderr. The validation record distinguishes pass, failed, censored and unsupported per control.

The backend ingests all 21 archived systems without 64-bit integer loss, but does not solve their natural public targets. Its documented CLI and machine-readable output preserve complete candidate variables, resource/censor classifications and raw stdout/stderr paths.

Independent Sage vectors cover 64 fixed-seed field identities, 16 valid and 16 altered S3 triples; four synthetic 63-bit ideals classify exact roots, certified inconsistency and positive dimension correctly; and one <=32-bit m=2 complete regression agrees with enumeration. A failure or censored control keeps the backend unvalidated and is retained verbatim. No full-width index-calculus solve occurs.
